scopeSemantics.release-target: Inside the HydraSeat v1 release qualification matrix; not a support claim until required validation passes.
scopeSemantics.experimental: May be exercised only with explicit warning/opt-in and is not part of the normal v1 support promise.
scopeSemantics.deferred: Intentionally outside the v1 release target.
scopeSemantics.excluded: Forbidden or explicitly unsupported by the v1 product contract.

hostPlatform.cpuBaseline: x86-64 CPU accepted by the selected Windows 11 release-target build; HydraSeat makes no vendor/generation performance promise before P10-PERF-01.
hostPlatform.gpuBaseline: GPU/display stack capable of the selected games and assigned physical outputs; vendor-specific performance/support claims require P10-PERF-01 evidence.

capabilities.notes: Two-Seat v1 requires physical display groups; real placement, mixed-DPI, reconnect and rollback remain release evidence.
Virtual display/IDD support must not become a dependency of the physical-monitor v1 path.
Release requires two physical input sets and objective receiver-aware zero-bleed evidence for the declared path.
XInput is a distinct controller API and requires scenario-specific physical evidence.
DirectInput is a distinct controller API and requires scenario-specific physical evidence.
Raw HID, SDL and vendor controller APIs are not implied by XInput/DirectInput evidence.
Only exact tested endpoint/session routing scenarios are in scope; unsupported movement fails closed or uses explicit user-assisted configuration.
Read-only local discovery and normal Steam launch URI path only; no credential or launcher-policy bypass.
Explicit local executable fallback with bounded arguments and no shell execution.
Provider-neutral interfaces remain extensible, but these live adapters are not required for the initial v1 release scope.
v1 requires at least one permitted real same-title demonstration; this is not a universal multi-instance promise.
Protected titles may only be explicit experiments and never imply anti-cheat safety or bypass.
No optional driver is part of the normal release target until signing, recovery and physical-safety evidence exist.
Local-first evidence remains authoritative; sharing is explicit opt-in with exact redacted preview.

externalResearch.use: Release-target Windows build-family snapshot only; no source code copied or adapted.
